sample_design: 1 source from each of ATT/BLF/CNC/CTL/LRN/MEM/PRD/SKL plus 2 challenge sources
selection_algorithm: For each primary stratum choose the slot with lexicographically smallest SHA256(exact_parent_head + '|' + salt + '|' + slot_id). For challenge slots choose the two smallest digests globally.
independence_contract: Coder must be a real human who did not produce the retained source extraction.

Coder starts from the original source identified by DOI/edition and does not receive the frozen ClaimIR, structural adjudication, bounded-object memberships, grammar verdict, capacity-case result, or answer key during extraction.

Coder independently identifies one focal source-grounded cognitive claim and constructs a structured claim record: scope/modality, typed nodes, typed relations, temporal information, and source locators.
No ChatGPT/LLM/CI/Lean output counts as an independent human judgment.
Only after the completed records are frozen may agreement/disagreement with the retained records be computed.
reporting_if_performed: role-wise node and relation alignment after an explicit matching rule
no reliability statistic before all required human records are supplied
mandatory_limitation: Procedural auditability is established; inter-rater reliability remains unmeasured.
